FORM 10-Q
Acme Robotics Inc. (Exact name of registrant as specified in its charter)
For the quarterly period ended March 31, 2026
Trading Symbol(s) ARBT Nasdaq Global Market
Management's Discussion and Analysis
Revenue was $120.4 million for the three months ended March 31, 2026 compared to $112.0 million for the prior-year period. Net income was $12.3 million compared with net income of $6.8 million in the prior-year period. Cash and cash equivalents were $220.0 million at March 31, 2026. Management attributed the improvement to higher gross margin and disciplined operating expense growth.
